results.market_title: Will MrBeast hit 139 billion views by August 31?
results.reasoning: Cross-referencing multiple third-party trackers (vidIQ, ChannelMetrics, VidMaestro, HypeAuditor subscriber counts) and extrapolating from a known June 27 (131.3B) to Aug 9 (136.35B) growth rate of ~117M views/day, MrBeast's channel is estimated to sit at roughly 138.6-138.8B total views as of Aug 29, 2026, needing about 300-400M more views in the ~2.5 days remaining until the Aug 31 11:59pm ET deadline — almost exactly matching his typical daily growth rate, making this a near coin-flip. A newly implemented YouTube policy (effective 8/24/2026) that counts views from the first frame rather than after ~30 seconds could modestly accelerate view accrual right in this window, providing some upside tilt, while data noise across trackers (ranging from 133.7B to 138.3B for supposedly 'current' figures) creates meaningful uncertainty in the true starting point.
